status: Supplementary diagnostic specified while the main experiment is running, before inspecting holdout outputs.
motivation: Development only: all six German cases produced citation objects rather than source_id strings across the original three strategies. Separate schema compliance from content selection without altering actual strict success.
normalization: Only parseable strict JSON with exactly answer/citations; normalize citations items exactly {source_id: string} into that string. The resulting answer/citations types, nonempty strings and unique citations must satisfy the unchanged core validator. Otherwise preserve the original failing response.
interpretation: If the new method has no content-score advantage, report that the measured gain is schema compliance rather than demonstrated better answer selection. Even a content advantage does not establish general reasoning improvement.
